title: Project
description: One case study. GET /projects/{slug} returns exactly this object; GET /projects returns an array of them. Validated against all 5 existing case studies. Apply validation at publish time, not on save, so drafts can be incomplete.

slug.description: Public URL segment: /case-studies/{slug}. Unique and stable — changing it breaks live links, so warn before allowing an edit.

titleLead.description: Optional first line of the hero title, styled differently. e.g. "SYCAMORE'S" above "DESIGN SYSTEM".

title.description: Hero title. Uppercase by convention. Wraps if long — no length limit needed beyond sanity.

summary.description: One-paragraph description under the hero title. Also used as the page meta description.

tags.description: Category chips under the title, e.g. ["FINTECH", "SYSTEM DESIGN"].

meta.description: The hero meta grid. All three keys are shown.

timeline.description: Free text, not dates. e.g. "2024 — Continuously Growing".

live.description: Optional "View Live App" button. Omit the whole object when there is nothing to link to.

thumbnail.description: Card image on the home grid and the banner at the top of the case study.

heroDevices.description: Optional device mockups in the hero. Currently rendered without intrinsic dimensions, so width/height are not required here.

accentColor.description: Hero background tint. Text colour is derived from it in the frontend — do not store a text colour.

order.description: Sort key for the home grid. Drag-to-reorder in the admin; do not make her type integers.

nextProjectSlug.description: DEPRECATED — slug of the 'Next Project' card. Dangles when the target project is deleted. Prefer deriving 'next' from `order` and dropping this field.

sections.description: Named sections, keyed by role — NOT an array. Key order is irrelevant: the frontend renders in its own fixed order (overview, problem, goals, process, design, collaboration, challenges, impact, reflection). A project omits any section it does not have.

eyebrow.description: Small label above the section. NOT always the section key — the `design` section of one project is labelled "SOLUTION BUILT".

heading.description: Optional larger heading. Supported by the frontend but unused by every current case study.

blocks.description: The section's content, in display order. This is the array she reorders in the admin.

block.description: A discriminated union on `kind`. Nine variants. An unrecognised kind renders as nothing.

textBlock.description: Prose. `heading` is the ONE subsection-heading mechanism — do not add a second one anywhere else.

paragraphs.description: One string per paragraph. Inline **bold** markdown is parsed on render.

quoteBlock.description: Pull-quote, rendered with a left accent border.

width.description: LAYOUT hint — how wide the image sits on the page. Unrelated to image.width, which is intrinsic pixels.

videoBlock.description: Self-hosted mp4. Autoplaying video must also be muted.

poster.description: Still frame shown before playback. Strongly recommended.

audioBlock.description: Audio clip. With no `src` the frontend renders a muted-speaker placeholder, which is how a section is parked while she waits on the file.

galleryBlock.description: Grid of images with one shared caption underneath.

images.description: May be empty — an empty gallery renders nothing, which is how a section is parked while she waits on assets.

src.description: Absolute CDN URL, or a root-relative path while assets are local.

alt.description: Required in the admin, not skippable.

caption.description: Optional caption rendered under this specific image.

width.description: INTRINSIC pixel width, recorded by the upload pipeline — never typed by hand.

sizedImage.description: An imageRef where intrinsic width and height are mandatory. Every rendered content image uses this: without real dimensions the page cannot reserve space, which causes layout shift and breaks scroll-triggered animation positions.
